target_customer: Product designers and designer-engineers who use coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex
problem: Designers cannot easily explore many UI directions in real code; design backlogs pile up.
business_model: SaaS subscription for individuals and teams, pricing not found
product_category: AI design agent for coding agents

founders.name: Sam Gorman
prior_employers: Snorkel AI (early product engineer, AI products for non technical users)
education: Stanford, Product Design and Computer Science
founders.background_notes: YC page says he started as a product designer and built an app with 100,000+ users.

technical_complexity.rationale: Running many parallel design branches in copies of a real codebase and merging chosen output is standard engineering on top of coding agents.

defensibility.rationale: Easily copied by design tools and coding agents; no data or network advantage stated.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Search results mention Figma's agent can generate variations from a frame, but no date was established for it.

market_need_then: Rapid adoption of coding agents created a gap between design and engineering; evidence is the product's own framing of design backlogs, no external data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses rivet.design. A different YC company Rivet (rivet.gg, W23) exists, plus other Rivet brands, so search confusion is likely.

identity.voice_and_tone: Launch post titled 'Burn down your design backlog'

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; name collides with another YC company.

outcome_analysis: Rivet is a Fall 2025 company run by a design and engineering founder. It shipped a product update in February 2026 per a directory, but no verified funding, traction or press was found. Competition from Figma, v0, Subframe and Magic Patterns is crowded and the idea is easy to copy, so the outcome is too early to call.
notes: An aggregator lists 500K standard YC investment, unverified and not a round. Competitor list left empty because no sources dated near the Fall 2025 batch were found; Subframe, Magic Patterns, Onlook, v0, SuperDesign and MagicPath appeared only in undated or 2026 comparison pages. Some directory descriptions of Rivet conflict with the YC page.
